tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Cards sit on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, sheets, inputs. Lifted with shadow-card, never a border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control tracks, progress-bar tracks, skeleton loaders, the dimmed area behind nothing.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface. Also the hero balance card fill in light theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, metadata, helper text. Passes 4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside list groups. Decorative only, never a control edge.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, unselected chips and secondary buttons (3:1 against surface).

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Fill of the one hero card per screen (balance, payday alarm). Text on it is on-hero.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text and icons on hero.

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on hero.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime highlight: progress fills, active dots and key numbers ON hero only. Never text on light surfaces, never a large background on bg.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the floating log button. One primary button per screen.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Money in, proven transfers, success text and icons.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Success banners and badges; text on it uses positive.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a check: low-confidence OCR fields, cash gaps, snoozed alarms.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Warning banners; text on it uses warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overspent buckets, failed proof, destructive actions. Not used for ordinary spending.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Error banners; text on it uses danger.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Links, neutral tips, the cooling-off timer.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Tip banners; text on it uses info.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: bucket-living
tokens.usage: Living bucket: dot, split-bar segment, progress fill. Always next to the word Living.

tokens.name: bucket-fun
tokens.usage: Guilt-free bucket: money set aside to enjoy. Lighter than bucket-short so the two differ by lightness. Always next to the word Guilt-free.

tokens.name: bucket-emergency
tokens.usage: Emergency fund bucket.

tokens.name: bucket-short
tokens.usage: Short-term savings bucket.

tokens.name: bucket-long
tokens.usage: Long-term bucket. The darkest bucket colour, so it differs by lightness.

tokens.name: bucket-goal
tokens.usage: Any savings goal (laptop, plot deposit).

tokens.name: bucket-family
tokens.usage: Family support bucket.

tokens.name: bucket-business
tokens.usage: Side-hustle restock / business bucket.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, label-to-input gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a stack; list-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; list-row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margins on phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a screen title, big separations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero card, bottom sheets (top corners only).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, progress bars, avatars, dots.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every surface card on bg. Replaces borders.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating log button and toasts.
